prior.summary: New to this reviewed candidate catalogue and mechanism contrast; MC2023 prediction is prior, not first discovery.
prior.case_context: 2026-10-07 LuTaN2/TaLuN2 exact search found no experimental SC benchmark. Related CaM N2 layered nitrides have known superconducting phases, but they are different cations/chemistry and do not make this exact Lu/Ta ordered phase a benchmark. MC2023 source prediction remains prior.

Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Ta SOC and Lu electronic-shell treatment, cation order versus competing nitrides, and layered shear are case-specific risks. Full fine stress reaches .242 GPa and fine force .01729 eV/A; coarse force 2.19e-5 eV/A/P=.001 GPa and the nonnegative finite path/positive Gamma optical subspace support a bounded near-ambient local phase. No claim of global hull or experimentally realized phase.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Coarse/fine SCF both converge; complete source forces/stress, positive Gamma optical compression and no signed negative finite-path value support this model near ambient. All listed q outputs end JOBDONE/response convergence with zero routine errors. This is finite-grid local/metastable evidence, not exhaustive thermodynamic or all-irrep certification.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Replace Y by Lu in the frozen YTaN2 analogue. Volume decreases 4.316116%; Lu-N versus Y-N nearest distance decreases .0744086 A while Ta-N increases .00273149 A. Same ecut/smearing/degauss/pseudo-family directory and 4x4x4/13-q grid give all-ten lambda gains 45.878–51.321%, separate Eli mu=.1 12.416→15.539 K. The opposite changes in cation-N and Ta-N distances distinguish local reconstruction from a uniform-volume description.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare YTaN2/LuTaN2 at a common volume and with a consistent SOC treatment or one matched layer-shear/metal-N mode. Favorable: the 45–51% source advantage survives and the layer branch stays positive; adverse: SOC/order changes remove the advantage or a competing nitride path destabilizes the phase.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
